reviews.title: Good app, needs work
reviews.text: I really enjoy using this app with my brother. The team function for holding each other accountable is great, but it has some issues with very fundamental stuff. How come I can’t insert custom macros for my food? The app gets things wrong often, unless there is a nutrition label to scan, which isn’t always the case. How come I can’t delete a singular food item off my list and have to delete the entire category it is in? Just small changes that would make it so much friendlier to use. Still recommend.

reviews.title: Great Concept, Poor Apple Health Integration
reviews.text: I appreciate the social and community aspects of Better Together, which are great for staying motivated. However, the app falls short on essential automation, especially concerning Apple Health. It's frustrating to manually input my weight when my smart scale already syncs that data seamlessly with Apple Health. Given the price point, I would anticipate a much higher degree of automation, and this lack of essential integration makes the absence of a free trial even more noticeable. It feels like a significant oversight for a paid fitness app.

reviews.title: Absolutely Useless Rip-Off
reviews.text:
Myself and a group were excited to try a group weight loss app. We all paid for the app and dove in. It's terrible. 

Half the features don't work. It bombards you with notifications. I reached out to the developer - who said that I could cancel. However when I tried to - he denied it twice and forced me to keep a subscription I don't want. 

This is just barely half baked and way too expensive for something that doesn't even work. Stay Far Away from this one.

reviews.title: Great features hidden behind a paywall
reviews.text: My friends and I really liked this app and its features, however, everything but the weekly team update is paywalled. What bothers me the most is the free version is ad supported and you still don’t get access to anything a run of the mill calorie counter gives you access to. After the first day of use you are locked out without paying. I wouldn’t mind paying, but I don’t find that fair to my friends who are SAHM who don’t have disposable cash to throw at an app just to help them get healthy.

reviews.title: Notifications non stop
reviews.text: There is no way to turn off the annoying notifications about steps and stairs unless you turn off all notifications. And this isn’t a feature in pro either. Additionally, paying for this subpar app makes no sense unless everyone does, and for the price per year, no one in my group wants to do that. Plus, if you and your friends stay with the free version, you all constantly get updates that no one reached their goal steps instead of those notifications stopping completely. It’s just nonstop annoying ads and notifications. And why isn’t there an option for people who don’t want to lose weight but need to lose fat? Not everyone wants to be stick thin with no muscle. After our competition, we plan to never use this app again.

reviews.title: Need to improve performance
reviews.text:
The app is okay. It serves the purpose of fun challenges, but there are definitely performance improvements along with user experience that needs to be improved.

1. The app DOES NOT automatically sync when it’s opened.  PLEASE design and develop a way for users to manually sync with Apple Health. 
Even better user experience, design and develop a feature that allows the app to update and sync without having to open the app.

2. When removing a member from a challenge, the challenge disappears. The user then has to close and reopen to see the challenge. 

3. Also, when opening up different challenges, the week goal shows data from the wrong challenge.
